content:
Noah: quick sync on landing copy variants + routing before I lock the page.
Noah: high-level: one-line claim, one supporting benefit, one CTA. keep Hosted/Dedicated/Private distinct.
Priya: paste current hero drafts?
Noah: Hosted-hero: 'Hosted inference for teams that ship fast.'
Noah: Hosted-sub: 'Predictable latency, pay-as-you-go pricing.'
Noah: Dedicated-hero: 'Dedicated GPU capacity for mission-critical models.'
Noah: Dedicated-sub: 'SLA options and burstable pools.'
Noah: Private-hero: 'Run inference inside your network.'
Noah: Private-sub: 'VPC or on-prem with audit trails.'
Sam: microcopy: Hosted CTA = 'Start free trial', Dedicated CTA = 'Talk to sales', Private CTA = 'Request security demo'. keep consistent.
Lina: inbound routing plan: Hosted -> product signup flow; Dedicated -> sales intake form + SLA checkbox; Private -> schedule-security-call + auto-send compliance pack.
Ethan: tracking + lead scoring rules (proposal): signup -> score 5, sales -> 35, security-demo -> 70. include hidden field: product_interest=(hosted|dedicated|private).
Noah: handoff snippet for webdev:
Noah: ```
/hosted -> form:signup, hidden:product_interest=hosted, utm_campaign=launch_hosted
/dedicated -> form:contact_sales, hidden:product_interest=dedicated, field:sla=true, utm_campaign=launch_dedicated
/private -> action:book_demo, hidden:product_interest=private, attach:security_packet.pdf, utm_campaign=launch_private
```
Priya: webinar tie-in: reuse Hosted hero on webinar landing but change CTA to 'Register' and add a short field 'primary use case' to qualify registrants.
Priya: benchmark blurb for webinar page (draft): 'On production workloads, batching + KV caching reduced median per-token latency and lowered per-request compute by up to 3x.' flag for legal review.
Sam: legal note: avoid concrete % unless backed by a benchmark PDF. change to 'customers have measured' + link.
Lina: A/B test idea for Hosted hero: test 'Ship LLM features faster' vs 'Low-latency hosted inference' for 2 weeks; target product-engineers channel users.
Ethan: SEO asks: include 'hosted inference' in H1, 'dedicated inference' and 'private inference' as H2s, meta description to mirror key phrases.
Noah: tiny UI note: add small badge under pricing 'Reserved discounts available' and keep it non-committal.
MarketingBot: reminder: content freeze scheduled 2026-04-03 23:59 UTC.
Priya: who owns the final copy sign-off? Product + Legal + Growth. I'll create a checklist in Notion and @Sam will run the approval.
Sam: will sync with Product/Legal tomorrow morning and post final copy here. thanks all.
